articles.summary: Forestar Group Inc., a leading national residential lot developer, today reported financial results for its second fiscal quarter ended March 31, 2025. Net income totaled $31.6 million or $0.62 per diluted share Pre-tax income of $40.7 million Consolidated revenues increased 5% to $351.0 million Residential lots sold
articles.title: Forestar Reports Fiscal 2025 Second Quarter Results
